methodology: Every legislative district overlapping each OSPI school district polygon, found by sampling a grid of points inside the school district and recording which legislative district each falls in. The share is the fraction of sampled points, an approximation of area - not population. Overlaps under 2% are treated as boundary slivers and dropped. School and legislative boundaries do not match, so users should still verify representation with a home address.
